decisions.assumption: team members are given a username/password to track their habits
users complete each habit daily, and streaks are tracked daily
users can complete a habit on a missed day with a grace period
team members share their habits and see team progress
users can edit past check-ins by updating their habit data
users receive notifications when their streak is at risk
Team members can edit their habits directly in the app.
Users can track their daily habits and the streaks they've completed.
Users can set a grace period for missed days.
Team members can share their habits and team progress.
Users can edit past check-ins directly in the app.
Notifications are delivered to the user's device.
All team members are required to maintain their habit and track it through their streaks.
A user can complete a habit on their designated day, which becomes part of their streak, and they are not required to complete it on other days.
A user can complete a habit on a missed day by extending the grace period, which is part of their streak.
Team members share their habits and track progress across all team members.
Users can edit past check-ins by providing the necessary details and updating the information.
Notifications are sent to the user's device and team members when their streak is at risk.
